# Everglow: AI Journal

> Everglow is an AI journal for iPhone by Haoyu Xu. You write entries in your own words; Everglow lets you ask questions across your journal, talk entries through with an AI companion, and revisit the people and places you write about. Your journal archive is stored locally on your iPhone, and you choose where AI runs: on-device, with your own API key, or through the optional Everglow Cloud subscription. Not related to the K-pop group EVERGLOW.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/everglow-ai-journal/id6775044981).
- Languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, French and Spanish.
- Free to start: up to 7 journal entries and 10 companion chat turns.
- Everglow Unlimited: a one-time purchase that permanently removes the entry and companion-chat limits. It does not include hosted AI.
- Everglow Cloud: an optional subscription for hosted AI with a monthly usage allowance; request context goes through Everglow's service to OpenAI, and Everglow retains no content after the request completes. Entry and chat limits are lifted while it is active.
- On-device AI: runs on the iPhone after a one-time model download (about 2.6 GB), so writing and AI features work offline. Availability and performance depend on the device.
- Your own API key: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini or DeepSeek; that provider's policies and charges apply.
- Everglow never uses your writing to train any model. You can also write without AI.
- Import: entry review before import for Markdown, plain text, folders, ZIP, CSV and JSON. A complete transfer of media, tags, titles or PDFs from another journal app is not assured.
- Export: dated entries and conversations as plain, unencrypted Markdown in a ZIP. Optional iCloud backup stores an encrypted snapshot in the user's private CloudKit database.
- Prices and offers are shown in the app and vary by storefront.
- AI can make mistakes; answers can be checked against the original entries.

## Questions

- [What is an AI journal?](https://everglow.cc/what-is-an-ai-journal/): what Everglow does with your entries, and what it doesn't
- [Can an AI journal work offline?](https://everglow.cc/offline-ai-journal/): on-device AI and what needs a connection
- [Is an AI journal private?](https://everglow.cc/private-ai-journal/): where your writing goes with each AI engine

## Guides

- [Looking for a Rosebud alternative?](https://everglow.cc/rosebud-alternative/): Rosebud's free plan retirement (30 September 2026), Everglow's one-time unlock vs optional Cloud subscription, where the AI runs, and importing a Rosebud Markdown export
- [How to move your Day One journal to Everglow](https://everglow.cc/move-from-day-one/): export Day One as JSON and import it into Everglow 1.5; dates, text and tags carry over, photos, locations and weather don't
- [Can I use my own API key in an AI journal?](https://everglow.cc/own-api-key-journal/): OpenAI, Claude, Gemini or DeepSeek keys, what each request sends, where the key is kept, and the one-time Unlimited purchase
- [How does on-device AI journaling work on iPhone?](https://everglow.cc/on-device-ai-journal-iphone/): Gemma 4 E2B on Google's LiteRT-LM after a one-time 2.6 GB Wi-Fi-only download; what runs on the model, the memory-based context budget, and the trade-offs, verified against Everglow 1.5
- [Is there a journal app that remembers the people you write about?](https://everglow.cc/journal-that-remembers-people/): a page per person built from your entries, the sentence behind each fact, earlier values kept, and how to correct it
